say:1:1130978001:1.text: Nope, I don't want to. I'm not interested in the Dusk Lord's "treasure".
say:1:1130978001:1.source_cn: 不想。什么残阳神的宝藏……我是一点兴趣也没有。

say:2:1130978002:1.text: We all grew up out here and have never heard any stories about treasure. I don't know why anyone would believe those outsiders.
say:2:1130978002:1.source_cn: 大家都是从小长在高原上，压根没听说过有什么宝藏啊！不明...

say:3:1130978003:1.text: But if I speak out, I'm scolded for ruining the fun. What's the big deal?
say:3:1130978003:1.source_cn: 而且我说两句实话还得被骂，说我扫了他们的兴。这都什么事啊……

say:4:1130978004:1.text: I'm just going to hide here. Even if they do find treasure, I won't be jealous.
say:4:1130978004:1.source_cn: 我还是老老实实躲在这吧。就算他们真找到了宝藏，我也不眼...
